1. (Currently amended) A humeral implant comprising a first __humeral surface component__ removably attached to a second component, __wherein the first humeral surface component has a concave undersurface and the second component comprises a removably attached stem extending from the concave undersurface__.

2. (Currently amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface __component__ and said second component is a removably attached stem.

3. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface __component__ has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature, __the coronal radius of curvature differing from the axial radius of curvature__.

9. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface __component__ is [[spherically or]] elliptically shaped.

12. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 further comprising a concave undersurface for bony ingrowth material.

13. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface __component__ has a smooth articulating surface.

14. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said attachable stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

15. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 14 wherein said attachable stem is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal.

16. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 15 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a smooth, textured or threaded surface.

17. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 16 wherein said removably attached stem is round, square, or triangular.

20. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem has [[a variable length wherein said stem has]] __one of a plurality of different lengths, each stem extending__ from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

21. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface __component__ connects to said removably attached stem.

22. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface __component__ connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper[[,]] and a screw, __wherein the connection is by morse taper__.

27. (Currently amended) A __glenohumeral joint implant adapted to be implanted in a glenohumeral joint to provide__ a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus and an implant, __wherein the implant is adapted to define the transhumeral portal__.

28. (Currently amended) The glenohumeral joint __implant__ of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant.

29. (Currently amended) A [[repaired humerus bone comprising]] __humerus bone implant comprising__ a modular implant with a humeral surface __component__ and a stem, wherein said stem is __adapted to be__ anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of said humerus bone, __and wherein the humeral surface component has a concave undersurface__.

30. (Previously presented) The repaired humerus bone of claim 29 wherein said stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

31. (Previously presented) The repaired humerus bone of claim 30 wherein said stem is linear.
